findings.fix: Rename `tMin` to `tZero` (and `tZero_nonpos`, `le_tZero_iff`, `t_le_tZero`, `isGreatest_tZero`), matching the `t₀(ξ)` used throughout the docstrings and §3 of the cited reference.
findings.issue: `tMin M ξ` is the *maximum* of the attainable `t`: `t_le_tMin : K.t ≤ tMin M K.skewness` (line 248) and `isGreatest_tMin : IsGreatest {t | …} (tMin M ξ)` (line 322). `t ≤ tMin` reads backwards, and the module docstring and the cited Diehl reference both call this quantity `t₀`, not `t_min`.

findings.fix: Rename to `tMin_neg_right` (whatever the head name becomes), per `Mathlib/Geometry/Euclidean/Angle/Unoriented/Basic.lean:94 angle_neg_right (x y : V) : angle x (-y) = π - angle x y`.
findings.issue: `tMin_neg : tMin M (-ξ) = tMin M ξ` reads as a sign assertion about `tMin`, colliding with `tMin_nonpos` four lines below, and is inconsistent with the sibling `tMin_zero_right` (line 75) which does mark the second argument.

findings.evidence: Lines 228–229 and 237–240; conventions doc: "the name of theorem simply describes the conclusion".
findings.fix: Spell out the omitted operands and the conclusion, e.g. `one_sub_skewness_sq_mul_t_add_four_skewness_sq_mul_sq_eq_minkowskiProduct_self` (or state it as a `t_eq_…` form) and `minkowskiProduct_n_delta_add_smul_avgMomentum_eq_zero`.

findings.evidence: Grep hit above; `delta` already matches `ExclKinematics.delta`, so the mismatch is only on this one name.
findings.issue: `OffForwardKinematics.t` is the invariant `Δ²`, which this repo already names `tMom` (`EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Exclusive/Kinematics/Basic.lean:68 def tMom (g : Bilin V) (K : ExclKinematics V) : ℝ := g K.delta K.delta`). Two names for the same invariant, and a one-letter declaration shadowed by the pervasive variable `t` (e.g. line 263, line 323).

findings.evidence: Definition at line 28–29 is `x • basis (Sum.inl 0) + y • basis (Sum.inr i) + z • basis (Sum.inr j)`; `frameVector i j 1 0 1` (Kinematics.lean:286) is a light-like vector, not a frame element.
findings.fix: Rename to something describing the construction, e.g. `Lorentz.Vector.ofTimeAndTwoSpatial i j x y z`, updating `frameVector_def`, `minkowskiProduct_frameVector`, `frameVector_sub_frameVector` and the three use sites in `GPD/Kinematics.lean`.
findings.issue: `frameVector i j x y z` is an arbitrary vector in the span of `e₀, eᵢ, eⱼ`, but "frame" in this area means a basis/tetrad, not a vector in its span (Mathlib `Geometry/Manifold/VectorBundle/LocalFrame.lean:19: "a predicate `IsLocalFrame` for a collection of sections to be a local frame"`). The name promises a basis vector.

summary: Several names misdescribe their statements: `tMin` denotes the greatest attainable `t`, `tMin_neg` reads as a sign claim, and two lemma names end in a dangling `_add`. `OffForwardKinematics.t` also conflicts with the repo's existing `ExclKinematics.tMom` for the identical invariant Δ².
